The city's Tioga Park Campground listing and the Tioga Park Board page give the park manager's (701)-641-1533 (Google shows the same). Suggest phone = 701-641-1533.

The park board points to https://www.facebook.com/TiogaParkBoard (not read). Keep the city page.

UNVERIFIED: no rate is published anywhere official I could read (stored none). Hookups, showers, dump and the derived 'reserve through Tioga Community Center' rest on old sweep prose and The Dyrt; the city pages are silent, so they are left alone. A Google review (2 years ago) says the park manager reserved a spot for a 45-ft fifth-wheel; another (4 years ago) describes a two-month summer stay during work in town.
FIT / INCLUSION: real city campground (ND HHS roster: TIOGA CITY PARK, 312 NE 4th St, Tioga Park Board, 14 lots); a 45-ft fifth-wheel backed in per a review, so a 23-ft rig fits.
